climate: Summers are close to rainless. Vines draw on water stored in the soil, or on irrigation, but disease is rare.

blurb.text: A Paso Robles sub-area in the southeast. It lies on an old erosional plateau at the base of the La Panza Range, with alluvial terraces and fans.
